basic.name: Death Coil
basic.description:
Deals 164~~0.04~~ damage to target enemy.

Can be self-cast to heal for 275~~0.04~~ Health.

basic.name: Howling Blast
basic.description: Root enemies within the target area for 1.25 seconds and deals 68~~0.04~~ damage.

basic.name: Frozen Tempest
basic.description: Deal 36~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies and Slow them by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Heroes hit also have their Attack Speed reduced by 10% per second, stacking up to 40%. Frozen Tempest's effects last for 1.5 seconds.

heroic.name: Army of the Dead
heroic.description:
Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20~~0.04~~ damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240~~0.04~~ Health. Stores up to 6 charges.

Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.

heroic.name: Summon Sindragosa
heroic.description: Deals 230~~0.04~~ damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

heroic.name: Sacrifice
heroic.description: Sacrifice a Ghoul to restore 240~~0.04~~ Health.

trait.name: Frostmourne Hungers
trait.description:
Activate to make Arthas's next Basic Attack strike immediately and deal 71~~0.04~~ bonus damage. Dealing damage restores 40 Mana.

Quest: Killing a Minion or hitting a Hero with Frostmourne Hungers permanently increases its bonus damage by 3 and Arthas's Basic Attack damage by 0.75.

trait.name: Frostmourne Hungers Primed
trait.description:
The next Basic Attack deals 71~~0.04~~ bonus damage. Dealing damage restores 40 Mana.

Quest: Killing a Minion or hitting a Hero with Frostmourne Hungers permanently increases its bonus damage and Arthas' Basic Attack damage by 3.

activable.name: Icebound Fortitude
activable.description:
Activate to instantly remove all Roots and Slows. Gain 25 Armor and reduce the duration of Stuns, Slows, and Roots against Arthas by 75% for 3 seconds.

Each Hero Rooted by Howling Blast reduces the cooldown of this ability by 2 seconds.

activable.name: Anti-Magic Shell
activable.description: Activate to make Arthas immune to Spell Damage for 4 seconds and heal Arthas for 25% of the damage prevented.

activable.name: Path of Frost
activable.description:
Activate to instantly mount with 140% minimum Movement Speed. Taking damage does not dismount Arthas from this Mount. Lasts up to 5 seconds.

When Arthas dismounts, Slow all nearby enemies by 30% for 2 seconds and deal 66~~0.04~~ damage.

level1.name: Frost Presence
level1.description:
Increase the area of Howling Blast by 20%.

Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Howling Blast.

Reward: After Hitting 15 Heroes, Howling Blast's range is increased by 20% and it hits enemies in its path.

Reward: After Hitting 30 Heroes, Death Coil Slows Heroes hit by 50% for 1.25 seconds.

level1.name: Borean Winds
level1.description:
After Frozen Tempest has been active for 2 seconds, Arthas gains 10% Movement Speed.

Passive: Frozen Tempest's Slowing effects last an additional 0.5 seconds and its Mana cost is reduced by 4 per second.

level1.name: Rime
level1.description:
Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 3 charges.

Passive: Arthas heals for 24~~0.04~~ Health per second while Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned.

level4.name: Shattered Armor
level4.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Howling Blast have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

level4.name: Icy Talons
level4.description: Gain 3% Attack Speed for 2 seconds every time a Hero is damaged by Frozen Tempest, up to a maximum of 60%.

level4.name: Frost Strike
level4.description: Frostmourne Hungers deals an additional 115~~0.04~~ Spell Damage in an area and Slows enemy Heroes hit by 20% for 2 seconds.

level7.name: Immortal Coil
level7.description: Gain the healing effect of Death Coil even when used on enemies. If Death Coil is used on Arthas, it heals for an additional 75% bonus healing and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

level7.name: Rune Tap
level7.description:
Every 3rd Basic Attack heals Arthas for 5% of his max Health.

Passive: Each stack of Frostmourne Hungers increases Arthas's maximum Health by 10.

level7.name: Icebound Fortitude
level7.description:
Activate to instantly remove all Roots and Slows. Gain 25 Armor and reduce the duration of Stuns, Slows, and Roots against Arthas by 75% for 3 seconds.

Each Hero Rooted by Howling Blast reduces the cooldown of this ability by 2 seconds.

level10.name: Army of the Dead
level10.description:
Consume all charges to summon an equal number of Ghouls that lose Health over 20 seconds and attack for 20~~0.04~~ damage. Reactivate to sacrifice a ghoul, healing Arthas for 240~~0.04~~ Health. Stores up to 6 charges.

Whenever a nearby enemy Minion dies, reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 1 second. Takedowns reduce the charge cooldown of this Ability by 6 seconds.

level10.name: Summon Sindragosa
level10.description: Deals 230~~0.04~~ damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

level13.name: Deathlord
level13.description:
If Death Coil is used on an enemy Hero, launch an additional Death Coil at a nearby enemy Hero.

Passive: Death Coil deals more damage the lower Arthas's current Health is, up to a maximum of 50% bonus damage.

level13.name: Deathchill
level13.description:
Howling Blast's damage is increased by 2 for each stack of Frostmourne Hungers. 

Howling Blast deals 100% additional damage and Roots for an additional 0.25 seconds against Heroes under 50% Health.

level13.name: Biting Cold
level13.description: Each second an enemy is damaged by Frozen Tempest, it deals 15% bonus damage, up to a 75% bonus.

level16.name: Remorseless Winter
level16.description: Enemy Heroes that remain within Frozen Tempest for 2.5 seconds are Rooted for 1.25 seconds and heal Arthas for 3% of his maximum Health. This effect has an 8 second cooldown per target.

level16.name: Frostmourne Feeds
level16.description: Reduce the cooldown of Frostmourne Hungers by 6 seconds. Arthas heals for 75% of the Basic Attack damage dealt by Frostmourne Hungers.

level16.name: Anti-Magic Shell
level16.description: Activate to make Arthas immune to Spell Damage for 4 seconds and heal Arthas for 25% of the damage prevented.

level20.name: Legion of Northrend
level20.description:
Reduce Army of the Dead's charge cooldown by 5 seconds.

Each charge consumed spawns an additional Ghoul to attack nearby enemies. These Ghouls cannot be sacrificed.

level20.name: Absolute Zero
level20.description: Sindragosa flies twice as far. Enemy Heroes are Rooted for 2.5 seconds, and then Slowed by 60% for 4 seconds.

level20.name: Death Pact
level20.description:
Instantly double your stacks of Frostmourne Hungers, but it no longer gains stacks from hitting Heroes or killing Minions.

Passive: Takedowns grant 2 stacks of Frostmourne Hungers.

level20.name: Path of Frost
level20.description:
Activate to instantly mount with 140% minimum Movement Speed. Taking damage does not dismount Arthas from this Mount. Lasts up to 5 seconds.

When Arthas dismounts, Slow all nearby enemies by 30% for 2 seconds and deal 66~~0.04~~ damage.
